# Australian Curriculum Lessons

> Free K-12 lesson plans and teaching resources aligned with the Australian Curriculum across all major subjects.

Australian Curriculum Lessons provides educators with comprehensive, ready-to-use lesson plans covering Mathematics, Science, English, Digital Technologies, HASS, and Design & Technologies. The site offers both timely thematic units tied to national observances and foundational curriculum-aligned resources suitable for primary and secondary classrooms.

## Key Topics

- Australian Curriculum
- Lesson Plans
- Primary School
- Digital Technologies
- Science
- Mathematics
- English
- HASS (Humanities and Social Sciences)
- Design and Technologies
- Teaching Resources
- Years 3-6
- K-12 Education
- Free Resources
- Formative Assessment
- STEM

## Core Resources

- [Australian Curriculum Lessons - Homepage](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au): Homepage for Australian Curriculum Lessons offering free K-12 lesson plans across multiple subjects
- [Digital Downloads](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/digital-downloads): Digital downloads page for free Australian Curriculum lesson plans and teaching resources

## Digital Technologies & Innovation

- [Year 6 Digital Technologies: Smart Garden — micro:bit Moisture Monitor, Data Logging & Radio Networks](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/09/30/year-6-digital-technologies-smart-garden-microbit-moisture-monitor-data-logging-radio-networks-user-stories-%e2%86%92-algorithms-%e2%86%92-visual-programs): Year 6 Digital Technologies micro:bit smart garden project with data logging and radio networks
- [Cyber Security Awareness Month: Passwords, Phishing & Privacy](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/13/cyber-security-awareness-month-passwords-phishing-privacy): Digital Technologies and PDHPE cyber security lesson on passwords, phishing and privacy
- [Digital Safety & Image-Based Harms: 5-Lesson Unit on Consent, Privacy & Online Respect (Years 4–7)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/12/digital-safety-image-based-harms-5-lesson-unit-on-consent-privacy-online-respect-years-4-7): Five-lesson digital safety unit on consent, privacy and online respect for Years 4-7
- [AI Feedback & Formative Assessment in the Classroom | Years 5–12 Teaching Resource](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/12/ai-feedback-formative-assessment-in-the-classroom-years-5-12-teaching-resource): Teaching resource on AI feedback and formative assessment using ChatGPT for Years 5-12

## Cross-Curricular & Literacy Units

- [Writing Across the Curriculum: Cross-Discipline Literacy Unit (Years 4–9)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/07/writing-across-the-curriculum-cross-discipline-literacy-unit-years-4-9): Cross-discipline writing unit integrating Science and Mathematics for Years 4-9 with NAPLAN prep
- [Year 2 English Narrative Writing Basics: Characters, Setting, and Problem](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/03/year-2-english-narrative-writing-basics-characters-setting-and-problem): Year 2 English narrative writing lesson covering characters, settings and problems

## STEM & Science Lessons

- [World Space Week 2025 STEM Unit: Living in Space Design Challenge (Years 3–8)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/05/world-space-week-2025-stem-unit-living-in-space-design-challenge-years-3-8): World Space Week STEM design challenge on living in space for Years 3-8
- [Spooky STEM Lesson: Symmetry, Polygon Nets & Nocturnal Animals (Years 2–4)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/13/spooky-stem-lesson-symmetry-polygon-nets-nocturnal-animals-years-2-4): Spooky STEM lesson covering symmetry, polygon nets and nocturnal animals for Years 2-4
- [Aussie Bird Count Lesson Plan – Years 3–6 Science, Maths & Geography](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/03/aussie-bird-count-lesson-plan-years-3-6-science-maths-geography): Interdisciplinary Aussie Bird Count lesson integrating Science, Maths and Geography for Years 3-6

## Sustainability & Environmental Studies

- [Trash to Treasure: Recycling Week Classroom Challenge (Years 3–6)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/23/trash-to-treasure-recycling-week-classroom-challenge-years-3-6): Recycling Week Design & Technologies classroom challenge for Years 3-6 with sustainability focus
- [Water Watchers: National Water Week Water Audit & Poster Plan (Years 4–6 Lesson Plan)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/04/water-watchers-national-water-week-water-audit-poster-plan-years-4-6-lesson-plan): National Water Week water audit and poster lesson for Years 4-6 with conservation focus

## HASS & Social Studies

- [Remembrance Day Lesson Plan: Symbols, Silence & Stories (Years 3–6)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/21/remembrance-day-lesson-plan-symbols-silence-stories-years-3-6): Remembrance Day HASS lesson plan for Years 3-6 covering symbols, silence and stories
- [Halloween in Australia and Around the World: History & Cultural Traditions Lesson (Years 3–6)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/13/halloween-in-australia-and-around-the-world-history-cultural-traditions-lesson-years-3-6): HASS lesson on Halloween history and cultural traditions for Years 3-6
- [What Is an Hour? Exploring Daylight Saving & Time Zones – Years 5–6 Maths & Geography Lesson](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/03/what-is-an-hour-exploring-daylight-saving-time-zones-years-5-6-maths-geography-lesson): Cross-curricular Maths and Geography lesson on elapsed time, daylight saving and time zones

## Outdoor & Experiential Learning

- [Outdoor Classroom Day: 5 Fieldwork Mini-Lessons in 50 Minutes (F–6)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/06/outdoor-classroom-day-5-fieldwork-mini-lessons-in-50-minutes-f-6): Outdoor Classroom Day fieldwork mini-lessons in Science, HASS and Health & PE for F-6
- [World Teachers' Day Hat-Tip Media Project: Thank-You Clips for F–6 (Media Arts/English)](https://www.australiancurriculumlessons.com.au/2025/10/05/world-teachers-day-hat-tip-media-project-thank-you-clips-for-f-6-media-arts-english): World Teachers' Day Media Arts and English project for Foundation to Year 6 students
